description: Add visible_gifts and available_gifts counts to the 'Gestionar Invitados' popup. The GET /api/baby-gifts/invitations endpoint should return per-invitation counts: visible_gifts (count of non-hidden gifts) and available_gifts (count of non-hidden, non-reserved gifts). The frontend renderInvitations() function should display these as badges next to each guest.
steps: 1. Modify get_invitations() in c:\Users\acmls\Documents\Development\smart-home\services\baby-gifts-service\src\main.py: After fetching invitations and reservation_counts, compute visible_gifts = count of gifts where hidden is False, available_gifts = count of gifts where hidden is False AND reserved_by is None. Add these to each invitation dict before returning.

2. Update renderInvitations() function in c:\Users\acmls\Documents\Development\smart-home\services\baby-gifts-service\src\static\baby-gifts.html: Add display of inv.visible_gifts (e.g., '📦 X') and inv.available_gifts (e.g., '✅ Y disponibles') near the existing '🎁 N' reservations badge.

3. Add test in c:\Users\acmls\Documents\Development\smart-home\services\baby-gifts-service\tests\test_api.py: TestInvitationEndpoints class - test_invitations_include_gift_stats() that creates some gifts (some hidden, some reserved), creates an invitation, and verifies the invitations response includes correct visible_gifts and available_gifts counts.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/baby-gifts/invitations response includes visible_gifts and available_gifts for each invitation
visible_gifts count equals number of gifts where hidden=False
available_gifts count equals number of gifts where hidden=False AND reserved_by=None
Frontend popup displays both counts visibly for each guest
All existing tests continue to pass
New test for invitation stats passes
findings: Frontend displays gift stats in a summary header at the top of the invitations list showing both visible_gifts (📦) and available_gifts (✅) counts. These values are global (same for all invitations) since they reflect the total gift state.
